_notes.title: The name on the title card, 1 to 40 characters.
_notes.players: Two names, left then right, each 1 to 14 characters. The left player takes the left half of the screen (or the A key), the right player the right half (or L).
_notes.townName: Painted on the saloon's canvas banner across the street, and named on the title and the wanted posters. 1 to 28 characters.
_notes.theme: The time of day: sunset (amber sun, long shadows), noon (white light, short shadows, bleached ground), or midnight (a low moon, blue light, lanterns on the porches). Each has a light and a dark look that follows the device.
_notes.bestOf: How many rounds a series runs: 3, 5, or 7. The first to win more than half takes it.
